leads.title: Constitution of Honduras - Articles 112 and 116 (2005 amendment)
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on same-sex marriage and de facto unions, non-recognition of foreign same-sex marriages/unions, and prohibition on adoption by same-sex couples.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 2005 constitutional amendment, Article 112 and Article 116. No URL visible.

leads.title: Penal Code amendments - Decreto No. 23-2013, Articles 27, 321, 321-A
leads.documents: Hate-crime aggravator for crimes motivated by sexual orientation or gender identity, and criminal penalties for discrimination and incitement to discrimination/hatred/violence based on sexual orientation and gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited as Decree No. 23-2013 (Spanish: Decreto No. 23-2013), adopted 2013. No URL visible.

leads.title: New Penal Code effective March 2017
leads.documents: Retention in force of anti-discrimination Articles 321 and 321-A after LGBTQ groups consulted Congress on wording.
leads.detail: Cited as newly enacted Penal Code came into effect March 2017. No URL visible.

leads.title: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (IACHR) Advisory Opinion of 9 January 2018
leads.documents: Regional human-rights ruling that parties to the American Convention on Human Rights should grant same-sex couples access to all family registration systems including marriage with all derived rights; basis for Honduran marriage suits.
leads.detail: Cited as 9 January 2018 advisory opinion on accession to all existing domestic legal systems of family registration. No URL visible.

leads.title: Honduran Supreme Court same-sex marriage cases - May 2018 filings
leads.documents: Legal machinery/challenge to legalize same-sex marriage in Honduras relying on IACHR opinion; second case dismissed November 2018 for technical errors; ruling expected 2019 on marriage and adoption.
leads.detail: Cited as May 2018 suit by LGBTQ activists, second case dismissed Nov 2018, pending ruling reported Feb 2019 / May 2019. No URL visible.

leads.title: Ley de Policía y Convivencia Social (2001 Law on Police and Social Affairs)
leads.documents: Police enforcement power for raids, sanitation control, and arrest for going against modesty/morals; documented by LGBTQ organizations as pretext for harassing and detaining transgender women.
leads.detail: Cited as 2001 Law on Police and Social Affairs (Spanish: Ley de Policía y Convivencial Social). No URL visible.

leads.title: Red Lésbica Cattrachas - December 2014 report
leads.documents: Documented violent deaths of LGBTQ persons: 174 deaths 2009-2014 (90 gays, 15 lesbians, 69 transgender people), primarily in Cortés and Francisco Morazán.
leads.detail: Cited as Red Lésbica Cattrachas December 2014 report covering 2009-2014. No URL visible.

leads.title: Pew Research Center survey 9 November - 19 December 2013
leads.documents: Public opinion on same-sex marriage in Honduras: 13% support, 83% opposed.
leads.detail: Cited as Pew survey dates 9 Nov to 19 Dec 2013. No URL visible.

leads.title: AmericasBarometer 2017
leads.documents: Public opinion on same-sex marriage in Honduras: 19% support.
leads.detail: Cited as 2017 AmericasBarometer. No URL visible.

leads.title: CID Gallup poll 2018
leads.documents: Public opinion on same-sex marriage in Honduras: 75% opposed, 17% in support, rest don't know/refused.
leads.detail: Cited as 2018 CID Gallup poll. No URL visible.
